lines.text: Many learners say: I bought a one-piece for the party.
Better: I bought a dress for the party.
Dress! She has a blue dress.

data.wrong: I bought a one-piece for the party.
data.right: I bought a dress for the party.

en.tip: A one-piece dress is just a dress in English. Say “I bought a dress for the party.”
